personally responsible, in whole or in part, for obtaining, creating, protecting, funding, passing, or otherwise delivering a concrete governmental benefit, policy change, or institutional result.","clarification":"Code as credit-claiming when the senator explicitly links their own action to a favorable outcome. Qualifying actions include introducing or authoring legislation, securing appropriations or grants, negotiating provisions, successfully offering an amendment, obtaining agency action after an intervention, or claiming a decisive role in preserving a local facility or program. The result may be shared with colleagues; a senator need not claim sole credit. Announcements of a successful bill or agency decision count when the release clearly says the senator's legislation, request, advocacy, or intervention produced or helped produce it.","positive_examples":[{"document_id":"2318","explanation":"Durbin says he helped secure an expedited federal review and returned the South Suburban Airport project to the national federal-funding priority list."},{"document_id":"1862","explanation":"Baucus and Tester explicitly state that they delivered on their promise to secure $12.5 million for Butte military projects."},{"document_id":"4771","explanation":"Clinton claims she played a key role in preventing the removal of four C-130 aircraft from the Stratton Air National Guard base."}],"negative_clarification":"Do not code as credit-claiming when the senator only states a policy position, casts or explains a vote, criticizes another official or administration, requests future action, expresses support for a proposal or nominee, or merely announces an agency grant or decision without connecting it to the senator's own successful effort. Ceremonial statements, condolences, invitations, and general legislative advocacy without a claimed result are also not credit-claiming.","negative_examples":[{"document_id":"656","explanation":"Kerry criticizes the administration's port-security failures; he does not claim responsibility for producing a policy benefit."},{"document_id":"3501","explanation":"Tester pledges to fight future missile reductions and seek another base mission, but reports no achievement."},{"document_id":"805","explanation":"Shelby announces a firefighter grant awarded by DHS but does not say he secured, requested, or influenced the award."}]}}
